before.name: Element name
before.description: The XBRL/financial statement element name for the fact. Constant value 'EarningsPerShareBasic' in all 48,325 rows, so every row in this table represents a basic earnings-per-share element fact. This conflicts with the table name 'DistributionToOwner' (an XBRL element for distributions to owners); either the table is used to store the EPS-basic element name, or the source data mislabels the element. The exact reconciliation is unresolved.
